title: Freshness log entry
description: One line of a venture's freshness log (<venture>/knowledge/freshness.jsonl, Revalidating V-1, V-2, V-5, V-7): an on-demand revalidation (a tag, a folder path or a package marked stale, like revalidateTag and revalidatePath), a check that a record is still right without changing it (verify), or a phase change. Append-only; each append is also a line in the provenance log. schema/freshness.mjs writes and reads it.

event.description: revalidate: mark stale on demand. verify: a record was checked and is still right; its age starts again. phase: the venture changed phase

target.description: revalidate and verify: what is marked. tag: one record file and everything that depends on it. path: every record under a folder. package: every record of a package's record types

pivot.description: A revalidate of the validation package because the venture pivoted

account.description: The account a door with sign-in checked for this person
